TechNova Pvt. Ltd. -- Software Engineer (Backend)

TechNova Pvt. Ltd. is looking for a Software Engineer to join our platform team in Islamabad, Pakistan. This is a full-time, hybrid position (3 days in office).

Responsibilities:
  * Design, build and maintain REST APIs using Python and FastAPI
  * Model data and write optimised queries in PostgreSQL
  * Review code and write automated tests
  * Deploy services with Docker on AWS

Requirements:
  - 2-4 years of professional experience in backend development
  - Strong Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Docker
  - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field
Nice to have: Kubernetes, Redis

Compensation: PKR 250,000 - 350,000 per month, plus health insurance and an annual performance bonus.

To apply, send your CV to careers@technova.example before 15 December 2026.
